title: A landing whose range changes lookup_eval.csv or lookup_heldout.csv refuses a held-out row that rewords a tuned row
goal: S2 gap found by the SP-vayhvwfy review: a821b9a5d (ST-hcc7a3fd) landed four lookup_eval.csv rows identical to or rewording lookup_heldout.csv rows; backlog.py land ran rag.py eval and the contract lint and passed, and only rag.py eval --file on lookup_heldout.csv prints the REWORD lines (BG-mtyaxud3 removed the rows). A landing or sync gate whose range changes either file runs the held-out reword check and refuses on a REWORD line.

run: import sys;t=open("_tools/kg_sync.py",encoding="utf-8").read();ok="lookup_heldout" in t;print("sync gate reads lookup_heldout:",ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
import sys;t=open("_tools/test_sync_e2e.py",encoding="utf-8").read();ok="REWORD" in t and "lookup_heldout" in t;print("a sync test plants a reworded held-out row:",ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

gates.question: Where does the held-out reword check run: in the sync gate only (every landing reaches it through sync --push), as a land step and in the sync gate, or as a land step only?

notes: Planned at the 2026-10-10 whole-backlog triage, which the operator asked to end with every draft planned into a sprint or dropped (sprint 1 of 13, "Fitness 1: kb content fixes and the held-out guard"); the triage reviewer found it serves the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test F1: the held-out answer rate (lookup_heldout.csv).
